title: Guided setup for new admins
notes: A friendly setup wizard now greets new admins on the dashboard and walks step-by-step through getting the community ready — branding, categories, email, app icon and first members — with each step linking straight to where you do it.

changelog.text: Guided setup wizard for new admins — a step-by-step first-run flow on the dashboard, dismissable and resumable from a “Guided setup” button.
